create_bbox_entity: create a BboxEntity instance with position, scale, angle, and class parameters
compute_bbox_extent: compute the min/max/size extents in x, y, z of a BboxEntity
rotate_bbox_entity: rotate a BboxEntity by a given angle in degrees about the Z-axis
translate_bbox_entity: translate a BboxEntity by a 3D vector in x, y, z
sort_bbox_entities: sort BboxEntity instances using lexicographic or random sort keys
